description: The campus dog: an old, gentle yellow Labrador mix who lives in a doghouse at the foot of the hills in the north-east corner of campus, and leaves you alone unless you ask for it. Look in at the doghouse, pet it, play fetch with its frisbee, give it a name (it answers to whatever you call it), ask it to come along on the forest walk, to the waterfront or the summit, or say goodbye, when it goes home. Nothing is stored.

action.description: What to do. Default: look in at the doghouse.

name.description: The name you call the dog. With action "name", the name to give it; otherwise, the name you gave it before, if any.

name: visit_the_dog
title: Visit the campus dog
